hook: This fast has another name: the Fast of Philip.

verse.translation: Philip found Nathanael, and said to him, “We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, wrote…”

story: Today, Hidar 18, the church remembers the apostle Philip, who told Nathanael they had found the one the prophets wrote about. (Not the Philip from Day 1; that was Philip the evangelist.)
Philip was martyred while preaching to people who rejected the Gospel. When his disciples came to bury him, his body was hidden from them.
They fasted and prayed, and on the third day God gave his body back to them, and they buried him with honour. Then they kept fasting all the way to the birth of the Lord.
meaning: That's why Tsome Nebiyat is also called Tsome Filipos, the Fast of Philip. Philip's own words sum up the whole fast: the one Moses and the prophets wrote about has come.

sources.title: ጾመ ነቢያት: አስተምህሮ፣ ስብከት፣ ብርሃንና ኖላዊ (Astemhro, church teaching on the Fast of the Prophets)
ጾመ ነቢያት, Memhir Samson Worku (Mahibere Kidusan)
Coptic Synaxarium, Hator 18 (the same day as Hidar 18): the martyrdom of St. Philip the Apostle

review.notes: Confirm with Memhir Senay: that the Ethiopian Senkessar remembers the apostle Philip on Hidar 18, and the story of the three days.
